components.name: Pyre Lance
components.blurb: A forge on a stick. Where it sweeps, things stop being solid. The room it sits in is described as 'cosy'.
components.quirk: A beam that lights fires wherever it sweeps (40% a tick), but each shot adds 40 heat to its room: the Emberkin do not mind the heat.

components.name: Cinder Mortar
components.blurb: Lobs a shell full of embers. The embers do not all go where it points, and the Emberkin consider that a feature.
components.quirk: An incendiary shell with splash 2 and a 45% chance to light the target, but 15% of shots start a fire in its own room: the Emberkin shrug fire off.

components.name: Flare Turret
components.blurb: Bright enough to count as an argument. It runs hot and the Emberkin take that as a compliment.
components.quirk: Blinding flares stun the enemy crew in the room hit for 1.6 s, but every shot adds 30 heat to the turret: it overheats fast.
